title: Four Pianos

objectives.text: Haul the first piano up the stairs
Hold the rope at the landing

rewards.text: $25 a piano; the brothers become muscle Nick can hire
rewards.payNote: $25 a piano, and the brothers' bonus.

where: Walk-ups across the core; the Varelas apartment
mobile: One held button with a rhythm prompt; generous timing.
laterParts: Part 2: A heavier piano and a window landing; the rope is old.
Part 3: Pianos across the core, timing the swing past a window.
Part 4: The fourth piano is Nick's, sold in his Act 3 decline (if he sells).
